label: Input 0 or i at original positions 2-4 right after a 0/2/i
explanation: Very sparse unit (about 0.03% of steps). It fires only in the original phase, at t=2..5, mostly t=3 (75% of mass). Inputs are only 0 (75% of mass) or i (25%). Activations are stronger when the previous one or two inputs are 0, 2 or i (e.g. s 0 0 [0], e i 0 [0]), and in sequences with more digits. It never fires at the delimiter, in the copy phase, at t<2 or t>5, or on any other input token. The predicate gets about 89% of mass but only about 13% precision: most steps with 0/i input in a matching context stay silent, and which ones fire seems to depend on the exact prefix (the first token e/f/x/s/0 helps but is not sufficient). So the unit is a narrow conjunction over the early prefix and is not fully captured.
